detached_structure.evidence: A lattice or pergola-like structure sits at the front and right of the central house, and a small stone-like feature sits behind it. These could be attached porch or patio elements instead of separate buildings.

signals.notes: Dense mature tree canopy covers much of the yard, especially the rear and right sides. The central house has a clean gray hip roof, and a lattice-covered area with a paved side drive runs to the street.
